title: Old Dhaka Killings
subtitle: Urban mass violence in Dhaka during the Liberation War.
summary: Old Dhaka experienced targeted killings and mass violence during the 1971 crackdown and war. Including this event helps represent urban civilian suffering within the broader military history of the conflict.
heroTagline: Urban mass violence in Dhaka during the Liberation War.
whyItMatters: Old Dhaka adds an urban civilian-violence chapter to the Liberation War timeline.
